The '''''Wayfaring Stranger''''' was a poorly armed [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. Following the [[Battle of Bakura]], the ''Wayfaring Stranger'' transported passengers, including twenty [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]], away from the planet. Former [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] [[Denno Yanglan]], [[Rafe Shahverdian]], and [[Mayr Stillman]] sought passage on the vessel. Yanglan and Shahverdian intended to defect to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]], while Stillman, who was still loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], hoped to infiltrate them.
